about.title: About Us
about.heading: Quality healthcare for every patient in Damascus
about.paragraph: Lumina Health is a Damascus-based hospital network connecting patients with experienced doctors across all major specialties. Our team of consultants and specialists practise at leading hospitals across the city, from Al-Mouwasat University Hospital to Al-Assad University Hospital. We focus on making healthcare accessible — whether you need a routine checkup, a consultation, or a procedure.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about booking appointments at our Damascus hospitals
faq.q1: How do I book an appointment with the right doctor?
faq.a1: Browse our doctors by specialty, read their profiles and patient ratings, then pick an available slot that works for you. The whole process takes less than two minutes.
faq.q2: Can I reschedule or cancel my appointment online?
faq.a2: Yes. You can reschedule or cancel up to 2 hours before your appointment at no charge, directly through the patient portal.
faq.q3: What if my doctor cancels on short notice?
faq.a3: We will SMS you immediately and offer you an alternative slot with the same specialist or a full refund, whichever you prefer.
faq.q4: Will I get a reminder before my appointment?
faq.a4: Yes. You will receive SMS reminders 24 hours and again 2 hours before your appointment, along with directions to the hospital.
faq.q5: Can I get a same-day appointment?
faq.a5: Yes. We keep daily slots open for urgent cases in general medicine, pediatrics, and emergency care.
